text: At its meeting on June 2, 2023, the Nominating Panel - Corporations considered Item NC5.1, and made recommendations to City Council. Summary from the report (May 18, 2023) from the City Clerk: The Nominating Panel - Corporations must select candidates to interview for appointment to the CreateTO Board. Following the interviews, the Nominating Panel - Corporations will recommend two candidates for appointment to City Council.

City Council on June 14 and 15, 2023, adopted the following: 1. City Council appoint the following candidates to the CreateTO Board, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending June 16, 2027, and until successors are appointed: Ron Carinci, as Chair Marcie Zajdeman 2. City Council re-appoint the following candidates, upon their appointment to the CreateTO Board, to the Boards of Directors of Build Toronto and the Port Lands Company, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending June 16, 2025, and until successors are appointed: Ron Carinci Marcie Zajdeman 3. City Council re-appoint the following members of the CreateTO Board to the Boards of Directors of Build Toronto and the Port Lands Company, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending October 2, 2024, and until successors are appointed: Marni Dicker Dennis Fotinos Sandra Levy 4.
